objectiveShort: I architect and ship cloud-native systems across AWS, GCP, and Azure — then apply machine learning to make them smarter.
objective: Senior Software Engineer and Cloud Architect with extensive experience designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-native applications and robust web platforms. Proven expertise across multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and a deep commitment to DevOps principles, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and continuous improvement. Polyglot developer highly proficient in Java (Spring), Python, JavaScript (NodeJS, Bun, modern frontends), and C# (.NET), SQL and NoSQL. Passionate about leveraging Data Science, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning to optimize workflows, modernize legacy systems, and deliver scalable, secure software solutions.

bullets: Lead the idealization, architectural planning, and end-to-end development of new enterprise applications and high-impact software features.
Spearhead the adoption of DevOps culture and practices, ensuring a sustainable, secure, and highly efficient coding environment.
Conduct active AI research and implement machine learning insights to optimize internal workflows and enhance system capabilities.
Ensure rigorous compliance with current industry legislation while maintaining best-in-class software architecture standards.
Engineered and deployed high-performance backend features for web platforms utilizing Node.js.
Collaborated closely with Tech Leads and Scrum Masters in an Agile environment to translate customer expectations into scalable product increments during rapid sprints.
Architected and delivered new web platforms while executing critical maintenance and refactoring of legacy codebases.
Engineered scalable microservices in Python and successfully integrated third-party APIs to expand platform functionality.
Developed and launched the corporate website, aligning technical implementation with executive design expectations.
Engaged in co-programming initiatives with Senior Developers to accelerate technical proficiency and ensure code quality.
